description: User speaks a short utterance then falls silent (genuine end-of-turn). Same scripted trace replayed through VADDetector (uses vad_speech) and SmartTurnDetector (uses p_done/p_continue at silence-candidate). Each path produces a TurnSignal attributable to its detector via detector_id. Scenario is chosen so the two detectors would plausibly differ: VAD fires on silence duration alone; SmartTurn fires only when its model confirms p_done > p_continue.

fixture_conventions.dual_path: Every frame carries BOTH vad_speech (for the VAD path) AND p_done/p_continue/p_backchannel (for the smart_turn path). Task 13 drives each path from the same signal_trace by reading only the fields that path needs.
fixture_conventions.vad_path: VADDetector stubs the VADModel to return p_speech derived from vad_speech: when vad_speech=true the stub returns 0.9; when vad_speech=false the stub returns 0.1. The detector fires when silence accumulates >= silence_onset_ms (300ms, ~10 frames at 32ms). At silence-candidate it emits a TurnSignal with detector='vad'.
fixture_conventions.smart_turn_path: SmartTurnDetector stubs the SmartTurnModel to return (p_done, p_continue) from the frame's scripted values AT the silence-candidate moment. Because the SmartTurnDetector fires at the first frame crossing silence_onset_ms, Task 13 looks up the scripted values at that frame. The emitted TurnSignal carries detector='smart_turn'.
fixture_conventions.divergence_design: At the silence-candidate moment (frame-034, t_ms=1088), VAD fires immediately on silence duration alone. SmartTurnDetector fires at the same moment but returns p_done=0.85/p_continue=0.10 (end-of-turn confirmed). Both fire — but each TurnSignal.detector is different, which is what Task 13 asserts. The scenario is not one where only one detector fires; the ablation tests that each fired signal carries the correct detector_id.
fixture_conventions.frame_duration_ms: 32 — matches SmartTurnDetector and VADDetector defaults. 10 silence frames × 32ms = 320ms >= silence_onset_ms (300ms), so the candidate fires at frame-034.
fixture_conventions.p_done: Scripted SmartTurnModel output probability: likelihood user has finished their turn.
fixture_conventions.p_continue: Scripted SmartTurnModel output probability: likelihood user is mid-thought.
fixture_conventions.speech_phase: Frames 000-024 (t_ms=0..768): user speaks short utterance. vad_speech=true, p_done low.
fixture_conventions.silence_phase: Frames 025-034 (t_ms=800..1056): pre-candidate silence. vad_speech=false, p_continue dropping.
fixture_conventions.silence_candidate_frame: Frame 034 (t_ms=1088): 10 silence frames × 32ms = 320ms >= 300ms threshold. VAD and SmartTurn both fire here. p_done=0.85 > p_continue=0.10 — end-of-turn confirmed by SmartTurn.
fixture_conventions.frame_bytes_synthesis: Task 13 synthesizes the bytes argument to SmartTurnDetector.process_frame() from each frame's vad_speech flag as follows. For vad_speech=true (speech) frames: construct 320 int16 samples each with value 500, encoded as little-endian (640 bytes total: struct.pack('<320h', *([500]*320))). RMS = sqrt(500^2 * 320 / 320) = 500.0, which is >= silence_rms_threshold (100), so _frame_rms() classifies the frame as speech. For vad_speech=false (silence) frames: construct 320 int16 samples each with value 0 (640 bytes of 0x00). RMS = 0.0, which is < silence_rms_threshold (100), so _frame_rms() classifies the frame as silence. This encoding is deterministic and sufficient to drive SmartTurnDetector through the same candidate-firing logic as the VAD path.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: The strings in expected_events are fixture-internal marker labels, not Part 5 event_type values. 'user_speech_start' marks the first frame where vad_speech transitions from false to true (frame-000, t_ms=0). 'vad_silence_candidate' marks the first frame where vad_speech transitions from true to false (frame-025, t_ms=800) — the start of the silence window. 'user_speech_end' marks the silence-candidate moment (frame-034, t_ms=1088) where both detectors fire and the turn is closed. These labels describe expected observable outcomes of replaying the fixture; they are not emitted as Part 5 Event.event_type values by any harness component.

signal_trace.notes: silence frame 10/10 — 320ms >= silence_onset_ms(300ms): CANDIDATE FIRES. VAD emits TurnSignal(detector='vad'); SmartTurn stubs model returning (0.85,0.10) and emits TurnSignal(detector='smart_turn'). p_done>p_continue => end-of-turn on both paths.
